title: 2023 Panini Select Aidan O’Connell Concourse RC #58 Las Vegas Raiders
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2023 Panini Select Aidan O'Connell Concourse RC #58 trading card features the rookie player from the Las Vegas Raiders. The card is part of the National Football League (NFL) set and is perfect for any football enthusiast. It has not been autographed and is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini. The card is a great addition to any collection and is a must-have for fans of Aidan O'Connell.
